town.read_aloud: Millford clings to the riverbank below the broken dam, its lower streets still stained with the old flood-line. The wardens will pay to know the drowned chapel is empty.
town.referee_notes: Safe ground. The chapel lies two turns downriver; the broken stair is the only way in.

entrance.read_aloud: The stair from the surface ends in a silt-choked landing, ankle-deep in cold water. A single passage leads north into the dark. The air smells of river-mud and old incense.
entrance.referee_notes: The descent cell and the only legal cell for TravelToTown. One passage north.

font_hall.read_aloud: A shallow basin of black, motionless water fills the middle of this side chamber. Its surface does not ripple, even when the floor is disturbed. Emptied votive niches line the walls.
font_hall.referee_notes: The Black Font (escape-hatch beat): a character who drinks or scries sees a fragmentary vision of the chapel drowning. No rules cover it — adjudicate live (a save vs despair, referee's call).

nave.read_aloud: Two rows of shattered pews face a silt-caked altar, everything warped to a grey sameness. Behind the altar the wall curves away into a low apse where the gold still catches the light.
nave.referee_notes: The hub. The apse is the approach to the reliquary. A loud fight here is heard in the ossuary. The curved apse is squared to the grid (see manifest geometry note).

reliquary.read_aloud: A niche of flaking gold leaf holds a single iron casket, its lid sealed with wax gone black with age.
reliquary.referee_notes: TakeTreasure(feature_id='casket'): holy water, a silver dagger, 120 gp, and the Tear of Neth (a 500 gp gem). Needle trap on open (1d4). The Tear's scrying is an escape-hatch beat — adjudicate live.

ossuary.read_aloud: Bone-dust lies thick over a floor of stacked skulls. As the light falls across them, two robed shapes at the back of the chamber straighten, and turn, and come.
ossuary.referee_notes: Two Gravebound Acolytes, reskinned to SRD zombies (2 HD, slow, no special), stance pinned to ATTACKS and aware. Narrate by appearance — never say 'zombie'. They carry no treasure.
